tokens_version_restamp: 2.1.0 -> 2.3.0 on 2026-08-04 by /idea-render-mockup. NOT a re-render. Verified: every colour var this render injects matches design-tokens.yaml 2.3.0 in BOTH the light :root block and the prefers-color-scheme:dark block (3400 vars across the 23 re-stamped screens, 0 mismatches). Tokens 2.2.0 and 2.3.0 are additive on the colour and type surfaces a preview consumes. states[].hash was NOT recomputed and is unchanged — this stamp asserts palette currency only, not full input-SHA currency.
fixture_order_kept: Cards render in demo-data order — SO-001, 002, 003, 004 (Inactive), 005 — NOT Active-first. business_logic declares no sort for this screen, unlike direct-debits which explicitly sorts Active-first. Reordering here would be the renderer inventing behaviour the ViewModel does not have.
badge_variant_note: Active → primary-container, Inactive → OUTLINE. Unified with direct-debits on 2026-08-04 by /idea-sync; Inactive was secondary-container until then. The deciding argument was DESIGN.md's payment-disposition triad, which reserves secondary-container (#D3E5F5) for 'In progress' — a cancelled mandate rendered in the in-progress colour reads as a payment in flight. Outline also carries the de-emphasis a terminated mandate should have. SO-004 is the only outline row on this screen.
currency_folded_into_amount: ui.yaml so_amount composes '{item.amountLabel} {item.currencyLabel}'. Rendered as '£1,200.00' — FormatMoney resolves the currency INTO the label, the same convention direct-debits states explicitly and every other rendered screen already follows. Emitting '£1,200.00 GBP' would state the currency twice.
amount_colour_note: Amounts render on-surface, not error — this is a read-only view of scheduled outgoings, and red would read as failure (ui.yaml so_amount test_context).
frequency_coverage: The five fixtures cover two of the four OBIE interval codes the FrequencyDecoder handles: IntrvlMnthDay on the 1st / 15th / 28th, and IntrvlWkDay Friday. IntrvlDay and IntrvlYear are decoded in the ViewModel but have no fixture, so no cell renders them.
final_date_conditional: so_final_date renders only where hasFinalPayment is true — SO-004 (28 Dec 2025) and SO-005 (25 Dec 2026). The three open-ended orders correctly omit the row.
so004_next_row_omitted: RESOLVED 2026-08-04 by /idea-sync. so_next_date now carries `visibility: {item.hasNextPayment}`, mirroring the guard so_final_date already had, and hasNextPayment was added to StandingOrderRowUi plus every demo-data fixture (true on SO-001/002/003/005, false on SO-004). The render behaviour is unchanged — SO-004 still omits the row — but it is now what the spec says rather than a renderer judgement call overriding it.
unsupported_vs_empty: OBP exposes no GET for standing orders at any version (screens/standing-order-create/data-flow.yaml#server_capability_gap), so 'nothing readable' is the common case and is NOT 'the customer has none'. unsupported renders the info variant with no retry — the capability registry refused the call, so there is nothing to retry. Body carries demo-data's message + detail as one paragraph, since uiState.message is a single server string the fixture splits for readability.
empty_cta_now_rendered: RESOLVED 2026-08-04 by /idea-sync. The fixture was ahead of the spec: demo-data had declared `cta: Set up a standing order` since 2026-08-02 with no component to render it. empty_standing_orders now has an empty_create_button child navigating to standing-order-create. Gated on the capability actually existing — data-flow.yaml#server_capability_gap lists missing: [GET, PUT, DELETE, pause, resume], so POST is supported, and HSBC_Sandbox/docs/06-domestic-standing-order.md confirms /pisp/domestic-standing-order-consents + /pisp/domestic-standing-orders on UK Personal v4.0, the brand this app targets. This is also the ONLY inbound route standing-order-create has.
error_retry_always_shown: Retry renders unconditionally. StandingOrdersErrorKind carries no isRetriable flag (implementation#note), so unlike direct-debits this screen does not hide the CTA for ConsentRevoked. Rendered at kind NetworkError; body is the i18n string, which is kind-independent here.
pull_to_refresh: content declares pull_to_refresh with action RetryLoad — the same action the error CTA dispatches. Surfaced as a hint row plus data-pull-to-refresh attributes, since a static preview cannot show the gesture.
